desktop_navigator.description: Control the user's REAL visible desktop screen, mouse, and keyboard. Use this when the user mentions their screen, wants to click an open Chrome/YouTube window, or play media. Actions: 'find_and_click' (args: {'target_text': 'song or button name'}), 'click' (args: {'x': 100, 'y': 200}), 'type' (args: {'text': '...'}), 'key' (args: {'text': 'Return'}).

browser_agent.description: SILENT HEADLESS background browser. Use ONLY for silent background web scraping or data extraction where the user DOES NOT need to see the screen or hear playback. DO NOT use when interacting with the user's open desktop windows.

take_screenshot.description: Captures the active Linux desktop display to inspect what windows, videos, or apps are currently visible.

sys_exec.description: Safely executes a bash shell command (e.g. system commands, cli queries, process checks) with a 15-second timeout and returns exit code, stdout, and stderr.

web_search.description: Performs a live web search for a query and returns titles, URLs, and text snippets of top search results.

media_control.description: Controls audio volume, mute toggle, WirePlumber audio sinks, and Bluetooth status. Accepts actions like 'status', 'volume_up', 'volume_down', 'set_volume' (with 'value', e.g. '50%'), 'mute', 'unmute', or 'bluetooth'.

git_manager.description: Inspects local Git repositories. Actions include 'status' (changed/untracked files), 'log' (recent commit history), 'branch' (all branches), and 'diff' (unstaged diff stat). Accepts 'path' for any local project directory.

system_monitor.description: Proactive health monitoring: reports CPU load, memory usage, disk stats, battery percentage, uptime, resource alerts, and top 5 memory/CPU consuming processes.

run_tesseract_ocr.description: Runs Tesseract OCR on a given image file path to extract and return readable text.

fs_list.description: Lists files and subdirectories inside a directory path, providing names, types, and sizes. Accepts relative paths or ~.

fs_read.description: Reads and prints the text content of any file up to 10,000 characters. Resolves relative paths or ~.

delete_screenshots.description: Cleans up temporary screenshot files from Pictures/Screenshots and /tmp.
